definitionZh: 位置锁定器 CSS 属性指定定位元素的默认锚定元素 。 这种默认用于位置区和位置 Try,以及在不为这些函数提供参数时用于锚定函数(锚定器()和锚定大小()).
sourceDefinition: The position-anchor CSS property specifies the default anchor element for a positioned element. This default is used by position-area and position-try, and by anchor functions (anchor() and anchor-size()) when no argument is provided to those functions.
